svg.title: Two different link limitations survive precise timestamps
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Two different link limitations survive precise timestamps
Unity-rate offset estimate: unknown forward-minus-reverse delay
Current frequency bound from two corrected observations: stable path required
At 8 s: 0.0051 Hz reading + 0.0040 Hz aging = 0.0091 Hz; use 0.01 Hz envelope.
20 ns asymmetry creates 10 ns bias; more packets cannot identify that bias.
At 1.020 GHz: half cycle = 490.196 ps; fine / coarse-format bounds = 300.082 / 512.912 ps.
Resolving a cycle is not proof of accurate absolute carrier phase.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
